'''Hayashi Shrine''' (林神社, also read as Rin Shrine) refers to multiple Shinto shrines in Japan.

* [[Hayashi Shrine (Tonami)]] - Located in Tonami City, Toyama Prefecture.
* [[Hayashi Shrine (Akashi)]] - Located in Akashi City, Hyōgo Prefecture.
* Hayashi Shrine (Nara) - A subsidiary shrine within [[Kangō Shrine]] in Nara City, Nara Prefecture.
